description: This Java class 'CalendarEnumerations' provides static methods to generate EnumOptionData objects for various calendar-related enumerations such as entity types, calendar types, remind options, frequency types, week days, and nth day types within the Fineract project.

classes.name: CalendarEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to convert calendar enumeration types into EnumOptionData objects for use in the application.

methods.name: calendarEntityType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given CalendarEntityType or its integer ID.

methods.name: calendarType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given CalendarType or its integer ID.

methods.name: calendarRemindBy
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given CalendarRemindBy or its integer ID.

methods.name: calendarFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given CalendarFrequencyType or its integer ID.

methods.name: calendarWeekDaysType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given CalendarWeekDaysType or its integer ID.

methods.name: calendarFrequencyNthDayType
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given NthDayType or its integer ID.
